english.title: Knowingly / recklessly make / sign / deliver to HM Customs an untrue declaration / notice / certificate

english.legislation: Contrary to section 167(1)(a) and (2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

english.notes:
(i) Section 167 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that any goods in relation to which the document or statement was made shall be liable to forfeiture.
(ii) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the offences to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit on prosecutions
20 years
